infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CruiXe uses your location to match you with riders nearby and show them where your car is. It is only used while you are signed in and online.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Riders watch your car approach on their map, so CruiXe needs your location while you are online — including when your screen is off or you are using a navigation app. With "While Using" only, your rider's map freezes mid-trip. CruiXe never uses your location when you are offline.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: CruiXe needs your location while you are online so riders can watch your car approach, including when your screen is off. It is never used when you are offline.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: CruiXe uses motion activity to tell whether your car is moving or parked, so it can save battery while you are stopped.

extra.//: Values are read at runtime via expo-constants / process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_*. Do not hardcode secrets here — app.json ships inside the binary.
extra.note: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_* in .env before building. See README.
